meta.title: Ishiuchi Maruyama Ski Resort
meta.description: ~10 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station — a 236 ha legacy resort with 4,000 m runs, Sunrise Express combo lifts, and 24 slope-side restaurants.

transit.title:
From Echigo-Yuzawa,
10 min by car or bus.
transit.lead: ~10 minutes by free shuttle or taxi from JR Echigo-Yuzawa Station on the Joetsu Shinkansen — or ~5 minutes from Shiozawa-Ishiuchi IC. Day trips from Tokyo pair easily with 236 ha of terrain and 24 slope-side dining stops.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy Echigo-Yuzawa Station and Shinkansen — winter trip to Ishiuchi Maruyama

primary.title: 24 slope-side restaurants
primary.lead: Not a single mega food court — 24 independent lodges serve Koshihikari rice, local pork yakiniku, ramen, and set meals. Winter House Daimaru's smokeless roaster and Bird Land's house-made rice bowls are reasons skiers return for lunch alone.
primary.imgAlt: Koshihikari rice and yakiniku at an Ishiuchi Maruyama slope-side lodge

secondary.title: Sunrise Express & panorama terrace
secondary.lead: The state-of-the-art Sunrise Express combo lift links gondola cabins and heated chairs on one line to mid-mountain The Veranda Ishiuchi Maruyama — a panorama terrace even non-skiers can enjoy.

onsen.title:
Ishiuchi baths &
Yuzawa onsen loop
onsen.lead: From Hatsukaishi Onsen Jungparnass and Maruyama Onsen Kojokan near the slopes to Ponshukan's sake bath in Echigo-Yuzawa — design recovery and town walks in one snow day.
onsen.whisper: Day-use rules and hours are on each facility's official site.

jungparnass.title: Hatsukaishi Onsen Ishiuchi Jungparnass
jungparnass.lead: 946 Jido, Ishiuchi, Minamiuonuma, Niigata. Day onsen minutes from the slopes — warm up right after skiing. TEL 025-783-7888.
jungparnass.imgAlt: Ishiuchi Jungparnass — Ishiuchi area hot spring

kojokan.title: Maruyama Onsen Kojokan
kojokan.lead: 1873 Ishiuchi, Minamiuonuma, Niigata. Legacy Ishiuchi inn — verify day-bath availability. TEL 025-783-2219.
kojokan.imgAlt: Maruyama Onsen Kojokan — Ishiuchi ryokan bath

ponshukan.title: Ponshukan Echigo-Yuzawa sake bath
ponshukan.lead: 2427 Yuzawa, Yuzawa Town. Unique sake bath and tasting — evening town walk. TEL 025-784-3361.
ponshukan.imgAlt: Ponshukan sake bath — Echigo-Yuzawa onsen town

daimaru.title: Winter House Daimaru
daimaru.lead: Ishiuchi Maruyama ski area, Minamiuonuma. Smokeless-roaster yakiniku — a gereshoku favorite. TEL 025-783-4047.
daimaru.imgAlt: Winter House Daimaru yakiniku on Ishiuchi Maruyama slopes

ishidora.title: Ishidora
ishidora.lead: 194-2 Ishiuchi, Minamiuonuma. Legacy grill house with playful menu — après-ski dinner. TEL 025-788-0956.

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning: shuttle from station → Daimaru lunch → 4,000 m downhill → Jungparnass soak → Ishidora dinner → Ponshukan sake tasting.

sunrise.title: Sunrise Express combo lift
sunrise.body: Gondola cabins and heated chairs share one line on the world's latest combo lift — 10-seat gondolas overlook the Uonuma plain to mid-mountain The Veranda. Comfort cuts wait stress for families and first-timers.

gereshoku.title: 24 gereshoku stops
gereshoku.body: Italian, yakiniku, organic set meals, and hearty rice bowls across 24 independent lodges — local Koshihikari and pork draw repeat visitors who ski for the food circuit alone.

yuzawa.title: ~10 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa
yuzawa.body: ~10 min by shuttle or taxi from JR Echigo-Yuzawa — link GALA Yuzawa and Yuzawa Kogen with the three-mountain pass. Rent at the station to hop Naeba, Kandatsu, and other Minamiuonuma resorts.
